message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant found a phone belonging to victim, then used Alipay (Alipay small amount password-free payment) to steal 3723 RMB from victim's Alipay account. This is theft via electronic means. Likely "盗窃" (theft) or "诈骗"? He didn't deceive victim, he accessed victim's Alipay account presumably using the phone? He used the phone to access Alipay and transfer money. That's theft (盗窃) of electronic funds. Could be "非法获取金融账户信息" but typical Chinese criminal law: "盗窃罪" includes theft of money via electronic means. Also could be "诈骗罪" if he deceived victim, but no deception. So "盗窃". Possibly "非法获取他人金融账户信息罪"? Not in list. The examples show "盗窃;诈骗" for some cases. Here only theft. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
